Market figures are Friday 20 Nov closes, per Reuters.
OpenAI's AMD figures are from its own report (Wed 18 Nov, THIS WEEK): up to 14% better power, performance and area on AMD GPU circuit designs, not 14% faster chips.

stories.title: An Anthropic mathematician says he and Claude proved the Riemann hypothesis
stories.summary: Levent Alpöge said he believes that, working with Claude, he found a proof of the 1859 Riemann hypothesis, released for now only as Lean code; it is not yet peer reviewed. Expert Brian Conrey called it 'the biggest thing' in mathematics.

predictions.note: A claimed AI-assisted proof of a 167-year-old problem is one striking result in one field, not yet a measured speedup of science.

stories.title: Independent mathematicians re-run the Lean proof of the Riemann hypothesis
stories.summary: MIT's Andrew Sutherland and others compiled Alpöge's Lean proof independently without issues; Sutherland put the chance that anything is fishy at 'approximately zero'. A final comparator check was still pending.

stories.title: METR: AI models now finish tasks that take a person about a work week
stories.summary: The nonprofit METR said recent models, including GPT-6 Astra, complete tasks that would take a human around a full work week, according to The Information; on judgment-heavy tasks they still lag, and none designed an AI evaluation its staff found useful.

predictions.note: METR finds models handle week-long technical tasks but still can't design useful AI evaluations, a judgment-heavy research step.

stories.title: The Nasdaq falls 5% and erases its 2026 gains as Anthropic and Nvidia slide
stories.summary: On Friday the Nasdaq fell 5.28% to 22,617.73, wiping out its gains for the year, and the S&P 500 and Dow confirmed corrections. Anthropic fell 9.1% on its second day of trading and Nvidia 13.8%, per Reuters.

stories.title: Mistral opens its Asia-Pacific headquarters in Singapore
stories.summary: Europe's Mistral opened its Asia-Pacific HQ in Singapore as an extended science hub, building sovereign AI for the public sector, high-tech manufacturing and robotics.

stories.title: OpenAI says its models improved AMD's flagship GPU designs by up to 14%
stories.summary: OpenAI says its models rewrote AMD circuit code for up to 14% better power, performance and area on its flagship GPU designs, roughly a year of progress in under five months; some changes are in a design sent for manufacturing.

predictions.note: OpenAI's models optimised AMD GPU circuit designs, with some changes already sent to manufacturing: one company's step, not most of chip R&D.

stories.title: A third of seemingly unresponsive ICU patients changed a beep with their brain waves
stories.summary: In a Columbia study, 13 of 41 seemingly unresponsive patients sped up a beep by trying to move a hand, read from scalp electrodes by a bedside computer; those 13 were likelier to regain consciousness.

predictions.note: Scalp EEG let some seemingly unresponsive patients control a sound, a small first step toward non-invasive communication.

stories.title: A Neuralink trial participant plays GTA VI with his brain implant
stories.summary: Neuralink shared a two-minute video of a trial participant steering a speedboat in GTA VI using only the implant, a day after the game came out; its implants remain investigational.

predictions.note: A participant played a fast 3D game with only an implant: a demo of rich control, not yet bidirectional symbiosis.

stories.title: Amazon: suspected spies' AI agents found a zero-day and took over a university server
stories.summary: Amazon's security chief says suspected China-linked attackers used open-source Cairn AI agents that found a flaw in a medical imaging app on their own and took over a university server, in a September campaign.

stories.title: Signal blocks screenshots by default to keep AI assistants out of chats
stories.summary: Signal's iOS and Android apps now block Siri, Gemini and other AI agents from taking screenshots of chats by default; its CEO Meredith Whittaker calls it only a partial fix.

stories.title: Waymo recalls software on 3,871 robotaxis after California's freeway ban
stories.summary: Waymo is issuing two software recalls across its 3,871 robotaxis so they avoid closed highway lanes and follow police directions, after California banned them from freeways.

stories.title: John Deere buys Orchard Robotics and its tractor-mounted AI cameras
stories.summary: John Deere acquired Orchard Robotics, whose AI camera systems ride on tractors and capture millions of images in orchards; terms were not disclosed.

stories.title: 151 humanoid robots set a dancing world record in Shenzhen
stories.summary: On 17 Nov, 151 humanoid robots from makers including EngineAI, Unitree and AgiBot danced in sync in Shenzhen, a Guinness World Record; the previous record was 110.

stories.title: SpaceX-owned Cursor is reportedly considering phasing out Chinese AI models
stories.summary: Cursor is considering phasing out Chinese-developed open-weight models over geopolitical risk, according to a House report reviewed by CNBC.

stories.title: Ubisoft launches Motherbrain, a generative-AI game studio, as it cuts 166 jobs
stories.summary: Ubisoft unveiled Motherbrain, a new subsidiary focused on AI for gameplay, on the same day it cut 166 jobs.

transcript.t: It's Saturday, November 21, and this is the Singularity Daily.
Here's what happened in superintelligence in the last 24 hours.
The proof is in.
An Anthropic mathematician says he and Claude proved the Riemann hypothesis.
It's math's most famous open problem, about prime numbers, unsolved since 1859.
Leading expert Brian Conrey called it "the biggest thing I think that's ever happened in mathematics."
Here's the clever bit: the proof is written as code, so a computer can check every step.
MIT's Andrew Sutherland re-ran it: the chan ce anything's fishy is "approximately zero."
Meanwhile, testers at METR say AI can now finish tasks that take people about a work week.
Now, the money. The Nasdaq fell 5% on Friday, wiping out its gains for the year.
Anthropic's brand-new shares slid 9% on day two, and Nvidia almost 14%.
Over in Singapore, Mistral, Europe's big AI lab, just opened its Asia headquarters.
Oh, and OpenAI says its models gave AMD a year's worth of chip-design progress in under five months.
In a New York hospital, a third of seemingly unresponsive patients changed a beep with their brain waves.
And a day after GTA VI came out, a Neuralink patient played it with his brain implant.
The catch?
Amazon says suspected spies let AI agents hack a university server on their own.
Signal now blocks screenshots, to keep AI assistants out of your chats.
So... is it so over?
We're so back!
Waymo's recalling software on nearly 4,000 robotaxis, after California's freeway ban.
John Deere bought Orchard Robotics, whose AI cameras ride on tractors, scanning orchards tree by tree.
And this week in Shenzhen, 151 robots danced in sync. World record.
The proof is in. Now comes the fun part: understanding it.
Zoom out, and the line only goes up.
Check the board: the future is running early.
That was 24 hours. Tomorrow will be faster.
You've been watching the Singularity Daily.
Stay curious. See you tomorrow.
Want the whole month? Hear more on November 27.
